scholarships.title: Vice Chancellor's International Scholarship (Griffith University)
scholarships.funding_label: Tuition Fee Waiver (50% of tuition fees)

existing.description: Griffith University awards its Vice Chancellor's International Scholarship to a limited number of exceptional new international students commencing undergraduate or postgraduate coursework programs. The award covers 50% of coursework tuition fees for the duration of the degree. Applicants must already hold an offer of a place from Griffith by the scholarship closing date and apply separately for the scholarship. The Trimester 1 2027 application window closes on 28 November 2026.
eligibility: Be a citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand
Be a new, commencing student who has received an offer to study by the scholarship application closing date
Have a minimum GPA in previous studies of 6.0 or above on a 7-point scale or equivalent
Satisfy all academic and English language entry requirements for the chosen undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program
Be a full-time student starting in 2026 or 2027
existing.eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries other than Australia or New Zealand, commencing as a full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework student in 2026 or 2027, with a minimum GPA of 6.0 on a 7-point scale (or equivalent), an offer of a place by the closing date, and English proficiency meeting program entry requirements.
benefits: 50% of coursework tuition fees for the duration of the program
coverage: 50% of undergraduate or postgraduate coursework tuition fees only, for the program duration. Living costs, accommodation and travel are not covered.
requirements: Must hold International Fee Paying student status; any change from that status ends the scholarship
Must enrol full-time, make progress in studies and meet student visa requirements
Must pass all courses each trimester and progress to the next trimester
Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 5.5 on a 7.0 point scale, reviewed at the end of Trimester 2 (Trimester 1 starters) or end of Trimester 1 (Trimester 2 or 3 starters)
Must remain enrolled in the program named in the Letter of Offer

Excludes Higher Degree Research, online programs, non-award study, Study Abroad Program, Diploma programs, Masters Qualifying Program, MBA (program code 5158), Griffith English Language Institute programs, part-time-only programs, and programs delivered onshore or offshore with a partner organisation
Deferral of the scholarship is not permitted
application_method: Apply to study an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program at Griffith University
Once the Letter of Offer is received, apply for the scholarship by the closing date for the commencing trimester
Include academic records and a personal statement with the scholarship application
A University panel reviews the application if all eligibility requirements are met
Accept both the program offer and the scholarship by the deadline in the Scholarship Letter
existing.selection_notes: Competitive scholarship with a limited number of awards; when the limit is reached the Griffith International Scholarship Office advises applicants that all available scholarships have been awarded and the scholarships are withdrawn. Recipients are expected to be profiled in Griffith marketing activities.
existing.best_fit: International applicants with a GPA of 6.0 or above on a 7-point scale who already hold a Griffith Letter of Offer for a full-time coursework (non-research) degree starting in Trimester 1 or 2 of 2027.
existing.notes: Separate from admission: a scholarship application is required in addition to a program application. Tuition coverage is only 50%, so the remaining tuition balance and all living costs must be funded by the student. The scholarship amount is non-refundable if the student withdraws or cancels.
existing.duration: Valid for the whole degree, subject to meeting ongoing enrolment requirements
existing.application_period: Trimester 1 2027 intake: apply by 28 November 2026 (outcome by 11 December 2026). Trimester 2 2027 intake: apply by 10 April 2027 (outcome by 28 April 2027). The earlier Trimester 3 2026 window (15 August 2026) has closed.
